remarks: Welcome to 83 Courtland Hill St, nestled in the heart of a quintessential New England neighborhood that captures the charm and beauty of classic Connecticut living. This picturesque area is perfect for families, with tree-lined sidewalks ideal for walking your dog, biking with your child, or simply enjoying a chat with neighbors. Known for its kid-friendly atmosphere, the neighborhood comes alive during the holidays with festive decorations that light up the quiet streets, creating a warm and inviting community spirit.  Just 1.5 miles from Cove Island Park, this charming single-family home is a dream for outdoor enthusiasts. Whether you enjoy fishing, biking, exploring the marina, or spending the day at the playground, beaches, or tennis courts, you'll find it all within easy reach. The park also offers basketball, ice skating, and plenty of picnic spots for family gatherings.  Inside, the home features spacious rooms filled with natural light, offering a comfortable and cozy vibe that's perfect for relaxing after a day of adventures. Step outside to your private backyard, an ideal space for BBQs, entertaining, or simply enjoying a peaceful afternoon outdoors.  Conveniently located close to shops, restaurants, and transportation, 83 Courtland Hill St provides the perfect balance of suburban tranquility and urban convenience. Come see this delightful home and discover all the joys of living in this charming neighborhood!
